finding.claim: The index names list elements as fields but compares at list level, so its count differs from a per-element derivation.

comparison_rule: The index compares at LIST level: a Hebrew run in a list field counts as new only when it is absent from the same field of the same row in rows_v3_cwo18.jsonl, whatever its element position. A per-element derivation also counts a run whose unchanged element moved; that is why S2 derived 36 runs where the index lists 34.
